facts.text: The only major-college player of the 2020s to make 300 free throws: Zach Edey, 2023-24 — 310-436 FT.
Only two major-college players of the 2020s made 150 threes: Darius McGhee (2022-23: 162 threes); Antoine Davis (2022-23: 159 threes).
The only major-college team of the 2020s to lose just once (20+ games): Gonzaga, 2020-21 — 31-1.
The only major-college player of the 2020s to average 28 points a game (15+ games): Antoine Davis, 2022-23 — 28.2 ppg.
The only major-college player of the 2020s to average 25 points a game as a freshman (15+ games): AJ Dybantsa, 2025-26 — 25.5 ppg.
The only major-college player of the 2020s to average 12 rebounds a game as a freshman (15+ games): Norchad Omier, 2020-21 — 12.3 rpg.
The only major-college player of the 2020s to average 10 assists a game (15+ games): Yuri Collins, 2022-23 — 10.1 apg.

Just four major-college players of the 2020s dished out 300 assists: Braden Smith (2×, best 2025-26: 345 assists); Ryan Nembhard (2024-25: 344 assists); Jeremy Fears Jr. (2025-26: 328 assists); Yuri Collins (2022-23: 324 assists).

Just four major-college players of the 2020s made 100 threes as a freshman: Jake Hall (2025-26: 117 threes); Jason Roche (2021-22: 110 threes); Josh Hubbard (2023-24: 108 threes); Brandon Miller (2022-23: 106 threes).
Only two major-college players of the 2020s averaged 20 points and 12 rebounds (15+ games): Zach Edey (2×, best 2023-24: 25.2 ppg, 12.2 rpg); Vonterius Woolbright (2023-24: 21.1 ppg, 12.0 rpg).
Only two major-college players of the 2020s averaged 14 rebounds a game (15+ games): Oscar Tshiebwe (2021-22: 15.1 rpg); Fardaws Aimaq (2020-21: 15.0 rpg).
Just three major-college teams of the 2020s averaged 90 points a game (15+ games): Alabama (3×, best 2025-26: 91.2 ppg, 25-10); Gonzaga (2020-21: 91.0 ppg, 31-1); Arkansas (2025-26: 90.2 ppg, 28-9).
Most 800-point seasons in the 2020s: Darius McGhee, 2 (2021-22, 2022-23).
Most 7-assist-per-game seasons (15+ games) in the 2020s: Braden Smith, 3 (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26).
Most 3-block-per-game seasons (15+ games) in the 2020s: Jamarion Sharp, 2 (2021-22, 2022-23).
Most 3-steal-per-game seasons (15+ games) in the 2020s: Kellen Tynes, 2 (2022-23, 2024-25).
Most 90-point-per-game seasons (15+ games) in the 2020s: Alabama, 3 (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26).
Highest scoring average in a season in the 2020s: Antoine Davis, Detroit Mercy, 2022-23 — 28.2 ppg.
Most points in a season in the 2020s: Zach Edey, Purdue, 2023-24 — 983.
Highest rebounding average in a season in the 2020s: Oscar Tshiebwe, Kentucky, 2021-22 — 15.1 rpg.
Best field-goal percentage in a season (200+ attempts) in the 2020s: Max Fiedler, Rice, 2022-23 — 0.735%.
Best free-throw percentage in a season (100+ attempts) in the 2020s: Walter Clayton Jr., Iona, 2022-23 — 0.953%.
Most 7-assist-per-game seasons (15+ games) by one school's players in the 2020s: Purdue, 3 (Braden Smith).
Highest assist average in a season in the 2020s: Yuri Collins, Saint Louis, 2022-23 — 10.1 apg.
Most 3-block-per-game seasons (15+ games) by one school's players in the 2020s: Western Kentucky, 3 (Jamarion Sharp, Charles Bassey).
Highest steals average in a season in the 2020s: Jacob Gilyard, Richmond, 2020-21 — 3.6 spg.
Most 100-three seasons by one school's players in the 2020s: Liberty, 5 (Darius McGhee, Brett Decker Jr., Kaden Metheny, Kyle Rode).
Most threes in a season in the 2020s: Darius McGhee, Liberty, 2022-23 — 162.
8 major-college teams made 400 threes as a team in the 2020s (9 seasons). The most extreme: Alabama, 2025-26 — 450 threes.
Most losses in a season in the 2020s: Detroit Mercy, 2023-24 — 1-31.
Best team field-goal percentage in a season in the 2020s: Gonzaga, 2020-21 — 0.549%.
Most free throws made in a season in the 2020s: Zach Edey, Purdue, 2023-24 — 310.
Highest team scoring average in a season in the 2020s: Alabama, 2025-26 — 91.2 ppg (25-10).
Most team threes in a season in the 2020s: Alabama, 2025-26 — 450.
Most points of the 2020s: Mark Sears, 2,839.
Most rebounds of the 2020s: Norchad Omier, 1,694.
Most free throws made in the 2020s: Mark Sears, 773.
Most assists of the 2020s: Braden Smith, 1,103.
Most threes of the 2020s: Nijel Pack, 436.
Most blocks of the 2020s: Johni Broome, 419.
Most steals of the 2020s: Ace Baldwin Jr., 342.

method: College basketball (men's): each line is one Stathead (Sports Reference college basketball) Season Finder query over the decade's ten seasons (a decade is the seasons starting in its years: the 1970s run 1970-71 to 1979-80), run in a signed-in subscriber session; result rows and stable ids are stored as provenance.

Sports Reference's season finders begin with 1947-48, so the 1940s page covers two seasons and earlier decades are not in the record. Rebounds, assists, steals, blocks and the three-pointer (1986-87) arrive at different times; rules on a stat a season lacks return nothing. Per-game figures are totals divided by games.
